assumptions: Shaft extensions come out on opposite sides; blind caps close the other bores.

subassemblies.name: Housing
subassemblies.description: Split housing that carries both bearing pairs.

parts.name: Housing base
parts.description: Lower half of the split housing, cast-style aluminium, with mounting feet, a sump, two half-bores of 47 mm and two of 52 mm at an 80 mm centre distance. Size assumed.

parts.name: Housing cover
parts.description: Upper half of the split housing with M8 flange bolt holes.

parts.name: Input open cap
parts.description: Flanged bearing cap for the 47 mm bore, with a 20x35x7 lip-seal recess and 4 x M6 holes.

parts.name: Input blind cap
parts.description: Closed flanged cap for the 47 mm bore, with a spigot that locates the bearing outer ring.

parts.name: Output open cap
parts.description: Flanged bearing cap for the 52 mm bore, with a 25x40x7 lip-seal recess and 4 x M6 holes.

parts.name: Output blind cap
parts.description: Closed flanged cap for the 52 mm bore, with a spigot that locates the bearing outer ring.

parts.name: Flange bolt M8x40
parts.description: Hex bolt M8x40, class 8.8, joining the cover to the base.

parts.name: Hex nut M8
parts.description: Hex nut M8 for the flange bolts.

parts.name: Washer M8
parts.description: Plain washer M8 for the flange bolts.

parts.name: Dowel pin 6x20
parts.description: Dowel pin 6 mm x 20 that locates the cover to the base so the bores stay aligned.

parts.name: Cap screw M6x16
parts.description: Socket head cap screw M6x16 that fixes the four bearing caps.

parts.name: Oil plug M16
parts.description: M16x1.5 plug with sealing washer, one for filling or breathing and one for draining.

parts.name: Input shaft
parts.description: Steel shaft (C45 or 42CrMo4) with 20 mm bearing seats and a 22 mm pinion seat. Length assumed.

parts.name: Pinion
parts.description: Spur pinion, 20T, module 2, PCD 40, 22 mm face, keyed, case-hardened steel.

parts.name: Bearing 6204
parts.description: Deep-groove ball bearing 6204, 20x47x14, supporting the input shaft.

parts.name: Output shaft
parts.description: Steel shaft (42CrMo4) with 25 mm bearing seats and a 30 mm gear seat. Length assumed.

parts.name: Output gear
parts.description: Spur gear, 60T, module 2, PCD 120, 20 mm face, keyed. Steel.

parts.name: Bearing 6205
parts.description: Deep-groove ball bearing 6205, 25x52x15, supporting the output shaft.
